title: Supplementary Table A4 is headed as Placebo Test I and reports Placebo Test II
published: Table A4: Study A (Direct First): Placebo Test [[I]]
corrected: Table A4: Study A (Direct First): Placebo Test [[II]]
note: Table A3, directly above it on the same page, is Placebo Test I: its estimates sit near one and its n is the count of admitters for each item (327, 281, 31, 42, 206). Table A4's estimates sit near zero and its n is 506, the full Study A sample, in every row, which is the form of Placebo Test II and the form of Table A7, its Study B counterpart, headed correctly on the next page. Every cell of Table A4 reproduces from the deposited data as Placebo Test II. Only the heading is wrong.

title: The supplement's list of placebo tables omits Table A4
published: Of particular note are the results of the placebo tests, presented in Tables [[A3, A6, and A7]].
corrected: Of particular note are the results of the placebo tests, presented in Tables [[A3, A4, A6, and A7]].
note: The supplement reports four placebo tables, two for each study: Tables A3 and A4 for Study A and Tables A6 and A7 for Study B, each pair a Placebo Test I and a Placebo Test II. The sentence lists three. It leaves out Table A4, the Study A Placebo Test II, while naming its Study B counterpart, Table A7. The omission is of a piece with entry 1: with Table A4 headed as a second Placebo Test I, the headings distinguish three placebo tables rather than four, and the sentence names the three. The sentences that follow it, which count the questions failing each study's placebo test, are unchanged.
